title: review-inline.json
description: Structured review result written by this agent (output/json_formatter.py). Top-level keys are kebab-case; per-finding keys keep the LLM's names (underscore, e.g. upstream_status) except fix-status and future-fix, which are kebab-case like in verified-result.json. fix-status/future-fix and the top-level issues-fixed/future-fix are present only if the later-fix check ran (--fix-check, the default, in hybrid mode with findings). review-metadata.json carries the same issues-found / issues-fixed / future-fix keys.

commit.description: Omitted when reviewing a patch file

future-fix.description: One-line summary of the later fixes of all findings, null if none

fix-status.description: fixed: later commit already in origin/<target>; fixed-upstream: fix exists upstream only; not-fixed: none found

future-fix.description: Fixing commits with location, e.g. "5bf62f727580 (origin/SLE12-SP5); 89f0addeee3c (upstream)"; null for not-fixed
